# WO-281: Checklist state: corrupt and missing files recover without losing ticks
Status: done (merged 2026-11-12 as characterisation tests)
Vendor: codex
Agent: windows-tests (Owen Park)
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Kind: engine
Target release: 0.4
Source: in-house 0.4 groundwork batch 2026-11-09, CLAUDE-065 (in-house offline until about Nov 14; vendors keep working the queue)
Worktree: `.vendor-wt/wo-281` on `vendor/wo-281` from main
Tracker: issue pending (in-house syncs freemyid-pm)

## Goal
Make `checklist_state.py` robust against a half-written, empty, wrong-type or Windows-edited (BOM, CRLF) state file, keeping every tick that can still be read.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Table test: empty file, truncated JSON, a list instead of an object, BOM plus CRLF, unknown keys, and a tick for a removed checklist item. None raises; readable ticks are kept; unknown keys are ignored.
2. Writes are atomic (write to a temp file in the same folder, then replace): a test that fails the replace leaves the old file intact.
3. Paths use `pathlib`; tests use `tmp_path` only.
4. Existing checklist tests pass unchanged.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers, where cited, are from main at the time of writing; re-check them.
